ns2:section.sectionText: This studio course combines hands-on experimentation with AI art tools and critical analysis. Students will create artworks that use AI platforms to investigate how these systems reflect and shape cultural values and aesthetic judgments. Through creative projects, readings, and discussions, students examine AI both as artistic medium and subject of inquiry. Undergraduate Section. Seats are reserved for specific A&D majors and A&D minors. If you receive a "reserve closed" error, all seats for your major are filled, check back on December 1. Any available seats left on December 1 will be made available to all A&D majors and minors.
